raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer injected an unverified date string (“10/05/1912”) into the search query, creating confirmation bias and a DD/MM vs MM/DD ambiguity. This led to surfacing and amplifying an incorrect “October 5, 1912” interpretation from lower-quality aggregators instead of directly opening and verifying authoritative sources (e.g., ThePeerage) that list 10 May 1912, and it set off the subsequent loop without properly resolving the discrepancy.
